$comment: The release gate policy (Gate 4, ledger ENG-071, ENG-079; release model v2, G6-2, APR-JE-039). A build is classified by its CONFIGURATION, never by what someone calls it: demo flag on and noindex on is the demonstration channel (and only a REGISTERED fictional demonstration may use it); anything else is client-production. Everything the gate relies on is bound to the CANDIDATE ARTIFACT DIGEST, not to a commit. No channel may deploy: a deployment authorisation is a separate record family, reported and never acted on, and no tool in this repository deploys anything.

demonstration.meaning: the fictional Jade & Ember showcase: flags.demo true, seo.noindex true. It may be packaged as a preview for review. It may never be indexed or sold as a client site.

client-production.meaning: any build with flags.demo false or seo.noindex false: a real client site, indexable, with production metadata.

deployment: never performed by any tool here; a deployment authorisation record (release/deployments/) for the candidate, the relied-on release approval and the host is reported by the gate, but nothing acts on it

evidence.$comment: JSON files in engineering/release/evidence/. They are human or tool records of work the automated checks cannot do. Each is bound to the candidate artifact digest (build.candidate), not to the HEAD commit; build.commit records where the work was tested and must be the release commit or an earlier commit of it. A ci-run record also carries the summary of the verification record the CI job printed (verification.*), compared with what a full run of the current verifier must produce.

types.real-device: at least one iPhone and one Android phone, recorded by a person
types.screen-reader: NVDA, VoiceOver and TalkBack passes on all five pages, recorded by a person
types.browser-matrix: automated and manual results in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (decision D-11: Firefox and WebKit are tested before production deployment)
types.ci-run: a GitHub Actions run of the verify workflow for the release commit with conclusion success, with its URL

records.$comment: Structured records (lib/records.mjs). The gate reads only closed fields, never prose. Folders: release/approvals/, release/evidence/, release/deployments/. Who may decide: release/reviewers.json.
records.release-approval: subject.productionHost must equal the host of seo.baseUrl and not be a reserved, example, local, IP or preview/staging address
records.search-review: subject.searchDigest equal to `npm run release:search-digest` for the build, and subject.reviewed listing business-facts, structured-data and crawler-policy
records.deployment-authorisation: subject.releaseApproval (the in-force release approval relied on) and subject.targetHost
